messages:
maya: quick sync — can we align on the telemetry contract shape between runtime and enrichment? specifically: what the runtime must send, what enrichment can add, and what needs to survive sampling for cost attribution

arjun: scope? traces only or metrics/logs too?

maya: start with traces + minimal envelope for cost keys. we can iterate for metrics. main ask: make it impossible to lose billing attribution due to sampling / batching

leah: fwiw i'd prefer an explicit top-level billing key so downstream joins are cheap. keep enrichment blobs namespaced so they don't pollute query keys

maya: agreed. proposal sketch: top-level fields: `trace_id`, `timestamp`, `billing_key`, `sample_marker`, `spans` (array). enrichment can add `enrichment.*` keys. sampling should set `sample_marker` so we know why a trace was kept

arjun: +1 on top-level billing_key. also suggest versioning the envelope so we can change shape without breakage (eg `telemetry_schema: "r1"`). runtime SDK should set billing_key if available

leah: example minimal envelope we could enforce at ingest (pseudo):
```json
{
  "telemetry_schema": "r1",
  "trace_id": "...",
  "timestamp": 1670000000,
  "billing_key": "acct:acq-123",
  "sample_marker": "kept:trace-sampler:v0.3",
  "spans": [ /* span objects */ ],
  "enrichment": { "kvs": { /* optional */ } }
}
```

tian: two ops concerns: 1) adding billing_key to every trace increases index cardinality, 2) sample_marker proliferation could bloat storage. need to quantify cost delta before agreeing

maya: good call. tradeoff: either carry billing_key always or rely on a join from logs/metrics which is flaky. leaning to carry it but we should allow a hashed/bucketed form for high-cardinality customers

arjun: what if we allow two billing fields: `billing_key` (optional full id) + `billing_bucket` (derived hash for cardinality-sensitive pipelines). ingest can use bucket for indexing, full key stored in cold storage or referenced via ID map

leah: that sounds workable. ingestion pipeline: index by `billing_bucket`, enrichers can expand to full `billing_key` when needed but we keep queries fast for common aggregates

ops-bot: deploy: schema-validator v0.1 rolled to staging for telemetry input validation :rocket:

maya: action items: 1) leah -> open schema PR with envelope + examples (include hashed bucket option) 2) tian -> run ingestion cost delta estimate for adding billing_key + sample_marker 3) arjun -> add validation + SDK hook to set schema header and bucket logic

leah: taking the PR. will include examples for sampled vs unsampled traces and a migration note

arjun: i'll add sdk hooks this week, will ping when branch is ready

maya: cool. if we can get numbers from tian by EOD Friday we can decide whether hashed-only or full key by default

leah: noted. :thumbsup:

tian: will run quick sim and post numbers here, might need sample of last 7 days.

maya: thanks team — we'll reconvene after PR + cost numbers. keep the thread short notes-only pls :)
